mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with high federal funds rate.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with high payroll employment, signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong labor markets are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances with declining industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate, combined with a high GDP growth rate, signals a tightening monetary cycle with strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with strong growth
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening cycles with strong growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with low unemployment rate.

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales signals a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong retail sales.
